card.name: Everyone or others as subject of a wish
card.fires_on: Words meaning people in general, such as everyone, others, all, mankind, or people, right where a verb about what they do or know is expected next. Seen in general web prose, not drug labels.

modes.label: Everyone as subject
modes.description: The word everyone or all stands as the subject or object of a wanting, seeing or doing verb.
modes.example: Now<< everyone>> wants to be his friend.

modes.label: Others or people in general
modes.description: Words like others, people, mankind or else refer to a general group that will act next.
modes.example: Please tell<< others>> about it: Add Graham via his official

modes.label: After all or more
modes.description: A group word follows all or more and is about to take a verb.
modes.example: eventually all<< mankind>> will be inspired to join him in doing

card.writes: It promotes Chinese words for everyone knowing or recognizing something, so it pushes toward a verb of knowing or recognizing by people in general.
card.plain: It fires on words for people in general, like everyone or others, just before saying what they do or know.
